lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਜਾ ਆਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe re man chitavahi udam jaa aahar har jeeu pariaa ||
lines.translation: Why, O mind, do you contrive your schemes, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for your care?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sail pathar mahi ja(n)t upaae taa kaa rijak aagai kar dhariaa ||1||
lines.translation: From rocks and stones, He created the living beings, and He places before them their sustenance. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere maadhau jee satasa(n)gat mile s tariaa ||
lines.translation: O my Dear Lord of Souls, one who meets with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad param pad paaiaa sooke kaasat hariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, he obtains the supreme status, and the dry branch blossoms forth in greenery. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਨਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: janan pitaa lok sut banitaa koi na kis kee dhariaa ||
lines.translation: Mother, father, friends, children, and spouse - no one is the support of any other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sir sir rijak sa(n)baahe thaakur kaahe man bhau kariaa ||2||
lines.translation: For each and every individual, the Lord and Master provides sustenance; why do you fear, O my mind? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਡੈ ਊਡਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: oodai ood aavai sai kosaa tis paachhai bachare chhariaa ||
lines.translation: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕਵਨੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: un kavan khalaavai kavan chugaavai man mahi simaran kariaa ||3||
lines.translation: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thought of this in your mind? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh nidhaan das asat sidhaan thaakur kar tal dhariaa ||
lines.translation: All treasures and the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are held by the Lord and Master in the palm of His hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bal bal sad bal jaaeeai teraa a(n)t na paaraavariaa ||4||1||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, and forever a sacrifice to You - Your vast expanse has no limit. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਿਆਚਾਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਇਤੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiriaachaar karahi khat karamaa it raate sa(n)saaree ||
lines.translation: They perform the four rituals and six religious rites; the world is engrossed in these.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar mail na utarai haumai bin gur baajee haaree ||1||
lines.translation: They are not cleansed of the filth of their ego within; without the Guru, they lose the game of life. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere thaakur rakh levahu kirapaa dhaaree ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, please, grant Your Grace and preserve me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot madhe ko viralaa sevak hor sagale biuhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Out of millions, hardly anyone is a servant of the Lord. All the others are mere traders. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਧੇ ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਬਾਤ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saasat bed simrit sabh sodhe sabh ekaa baat pukaaree ||
lines.translation: I have searched all the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees, and they all affirm one thing:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur mukat na kooo paavai man vekhahu kar beechaaree ||2||
lines.translation: without the Guru, no one obtains liberation; see, and reflect upon this in your mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਧਰ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: athasath majan kar isanaanaa bhram aae dhar saaree ||
lines.translation: Even if one takes cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and wanders over the whole planet,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਚ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anik soch karahi din raatee bin satigur a(n)dhiaaree ||3||
lines.translation: and performs all the rituals of purification day and night, still, without the True Guru, there is only darkness. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤ ਧਾਵਤ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਧਾਇਓ ਅਬ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaavat dhaavat sabh jag dhaaio ab aae har duaaree ||
lines.translation: Roaming and wandering around, I have travelled over the whole world, and now, I have arrived at the Lord's Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਟਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: duramat met budh paragaasee jan naanak guramukh taaree ||4||1||2||
lines.translation: The Lord has eliminated my evil-mindedness, and enlightened my intellect; O servant Nanak, the Gurmukhs are saved. ||4||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਪ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan jaap har dhan taap har dhan bhojan bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Lord is my chanting, the wealth of the Lord is my deep meditation; the wealth of the Lord is the food I enjoy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nimakh na bisarau man te har har saadhasa(n)gat mahi paaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: I do not forget the Lord, Har, Har, from my mind, even for an instant; I have found Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਖਾਟਿ ਆਇਓ ਘਰਿ ਪੂਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee khaat aaio ghar pootaa ||
lines.translation: O mother, your son has returned home with a profit:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਚਲਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਗਤ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan chalate har dhan baise har dhan jaagat sootaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: the wealth of the Lord while walking, the wealth of the Lord while sitting, and the wealth of the Lord while waking and sleeping. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan isanaan har dhan giaan har sa(n)g laai dhiaanaa ||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Lord is my cleansing bath, the wealth of the Lord is my wisdom; I center my meditation on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan tulahaa har dhan beRee har har taar paraanaa ||2||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Lord is my raft, the wealth of the Lord is my boat; the Lord, Har, Har, is the ship to carry me across. ||2||
